mathematical_problem: finite time-expanded fixed-arc-cost shared-capacity linear assignment with commodity conservation and full-arc consensus ADMM
generic_candidate: Refresh L-BFGS dual curvature after active-set Newton whenever the original-unit local conservation target remains unmet; at most two further calls using the same R2 per-call limit. Retain the R2 nonnegative active-support correction and independent full-system checks.
frozen_input_rho_rule: R2 input-derived median positive arc cost divided by median commodity demand, clipped to [1e-4,1]
equalities: R2 all-node dual equality formulation; diagnose signed-incidence rank and redundant rows; verify complete original Bx=b independently; no row deletion is presently selected
scaling: R2 demand normalization; report original-unit PCE and normalized residuals
feasible_initialization: R2 input-cost shortest path, no LP solution warm start
feasibility_restoration: R2 positive-support least-squares correction if nonnegative; log pre/post residual; never hide pre-restoration failure
regression_rule: all ten previously accepted R2 cases must pass the independent R2 replay, R3 solver, independent R3 evaluator, and same-graph objective gates before source/policy freeze
fresh_transfer_rule: after freeze, build the locked input graph, solve one same-graph arc-flow LP, then run one frozen R3 ADMM attempt; no retuning
claim_boundary: bounded Hong Kong finite shared-capacity case only; not static UE, empirical validation, full 8930-OD assignment, or convergence theorem
